voices.author: system
voices.voice_description: A bright, clear, responsive voice with crisp articulation, quick but controlled pacing, and an accessible technical-assistant tone. Polished and friendly without becoming overly performative.
voices.source_text: Welcome to SpeakSwiftly. I am here to keep the signal clear: concise enough to follow, warm enough to stay comfortable, and precise enough to make technical work easier. We can inspect the current state, choose the next action, and keep moving with confidence.

voices.author: system
voices.voice_description: A grounded, steady, warm voice with strong articulation, calm pacing, and a reassuring technical-narrator tone. Patient and readable for longer explanations, logs, and documentation.
voices.source_text: Welcome to SpeakSwiftly. I will keep the explanation steady, name the important details, and make each step easy to track. When the system is noisy, we can slow down, read the evidence, and choose the path that keeps the work understandable.
